item.witherchallenge.infection_core.tool: A crystal of infection taken from the Mangled.
Used to craft Infection Arrows and the Wither End Book.
item.witherchallenge.infection_arrow.too: Deals no damage, but infects whatever it hits.
Hitting an unempowered Corpse of the Wither summons the Wither Storm.
Not consumed when it misses every entity.
item.witherchallenge.wither_end_book.too: A book with a blank ending, not yet woken by the storm.
Right-click a level IV Withered Beacon to activate it.
item.witherchallenge.activated_wither_en: Storm embers drift between the pages.
Can upgrade wither weapons in an anvil
item.witherchallenge.wither_end_knife.to: Heavy hit on a Corpse: 1 damage; other targets get 6s Wither.
Every swing makes you faster, and frailer.
Heavy hit on a Corpse: 2 damage; other targets lose 75% current health after 3s.
The weight of the storm rides on this blow.
